* **CloudNative Specific**: [how-to-file-effective-incident-jira-tickets-on-the-cloudnative-platform](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-430)

Steps to file JIRA with CloudNative Platform* Click link to file incident with CloudNativeV3:  <https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-476>
* Click link to [**CloudNative Platform Incident (v3)**](https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-210)
* Fillin these Values
	+ Summary - This is a Summary of the incident ... Example: Pod ABCDEFGHI failed to deploy CloudNative Environment due to okeinfra issue
	+ Fleet - The name of the CloudNative V3 Fleet ... This information can be found in the PipelineHub UI as the attribute "Fleet"
	+ Environment Name - This is the same as the POD Name (otherwise known as the System Name in the DevOps Portal
	+ Impact Start Time - Click on the Clock icon and supply a value, usually use the current time
	+ Description - Supply a Description of the issue (what steps did you perform to self-triage the issue and determine issue needs to be filed with CloudNative Platform)
	+ Press the CREATE button to submit the incident

retrieved_sources.text:
+ This support is available for source repos in GitService GitService only (not for GitPortal/Gitlab)
	+ Configure your GitService GitService Source Repo to ensure Linked Issues section shows up - Refer this [GitService document](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-012)
	+ Once above is done, PipelineHub will automatically report on Jiras linked to your MRs (as linked issues) in the Merge Requests Section
	+ 
	+ The jiras fixed in the build will also be shown under Linked Issues
	+ 
	+ In addition, If you would like PipelineHub to update the jiras after a build completes with status updates & build links, please perform the following steps:
		- Provide [user005@example.com](mailto:user005@example.com) user update access to your jiraboard (this is the user PipelineHub will use to update jiras)
		- Set the UpdateJiraStatus flag to true in Project Config → Common Section

	+ **Jira Updates**

**Guide through Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)**
--------------------------------------------------

* ### What is PipelineHub?

	+ PipelineHub is the platform for Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and Release Management of BusinessApplications.
	+ It supports both monolithic and cloud-native applications built with Microservices, AppPackages, Visual Builder UI & LowCode.
	+ To integrate your application's source code into PipelineHub for CI/CD, you must register each repository as a PipelineHub project. Before starting this process, please familiarize yourself with the [supported project types](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-003).

Central JIRAadf9d0b9-328f-38b2-a954-2899436ad300CloudNativeCICD-17323

To automate and standardize the nomination process used by Microservice and AppPackage development teams to identify which artifact versions should be promoted into specific CWB or sprint-exit service version. 

**Problem Statement:** While PipelineHub currently supports tagging at the cloudnative service/application version level, it does not support the component/artifact-level tagging at the CI/CD pipeline or snapshot level today, and auditability required for automated downstream validations and service-version creation.

+ Please add the label **releaseengineering-preflight** label as mandate to the Jira Ticket if the issue is for "Preflight" job to give extra visibility
* **Important Notes** 
	+ *Manual jar patching, or any pod related operations done outside of PipelineHub is not supported.*
	+ Please note all work on support issues is handled in JIRAs. Please do not Slack/Text team members directly for work on issues.
	+ All tracked work must be in JIRAs, including requests for updates since the Jira queue is what we work from.
	+ \*\*\*IMPORTANT: For any post provisioning / pod health related environment issue, please DO NOT log PLATFORM_PREFLIGHT Jira
